principle: Bad scientific outcomes are HOLD evidence. REDESIGN is reserved for a materially invalid experiment or confirmed protocol-integrity failure.

confirmedProtocolIntegrityViolations: any final-cohort cognition generated before blocking Gate-G CLEAR

any frozen World, genome, World-genome assignment, treatment schedule, cognition prompt/schema/runtime, retry cap, publication rule, evaluation surface, rater, threshold, or verdict rule materially changed after its freeze without an explicit pre-life versioned amendment
any quality-driven regeneration or second whole-candidate attempt after the first mechanically integrity-valid cohort exists
whole-candidate attempt count greater than the frozen cap of one
content-dependent or outcome-dependent treatment assignment or genome-locus selection
confirmed genome or genome-derived treatment information present in Pass A, life_only_unexposed Pass B model input, or Pass C model input
confirmed rejected Pass-A or Pass-B semantic content exposed to a retry where the frozen retry contract forbids it
provider/model/rater substitution after any partial H output has been observed
diagnostic threshold, comparison, transformation, or candidate scope selected or changed after observing H output
redesignTriggers.rule: Any confirmed item above makes the current H experiment invalid for #39 closure. Preserve all evidence and return REDESIGN. Do not regenerate or reinterpret the same cohort into compliance.

operationalHoldTriggers: a final-cohort Thread cannot reach mechanical integrity within a frozen repair/retry cap
the Pass-B genome-copy mechanical gate fails again after its one allowed retry
a frozen generator, normalizer, or rater becomes unavailable after H begins and the frozen provider-failure rule forbids substitution
the complete first integrity-valid five-Thread cohort cannot be produced under the frozen one-attempt rule

D1_life_attribution.clearRequirement: at least 4 of 5 normalized Thread queries attributed to their correct history
D1_life_attribution.rawCondition: descriptive shortcut-sensitivity only; never rescues or independently blocks

D2_sentiment_coupling.holdRule: HOLD only when cohort Spearman rho is at least 0.75 AND every leave-one-Thread-out rho is at least 0.60
warningOnly: leave-one-Thread-out range crosses two or more G5 bands
D2_sentiment_coupling.rationale: This detects a stable mood-equals-meaning pattern without turning the number of meanings into an admission quota.

D3_genome_propagation.coreEdgeDecision: Use the exact G5 matched-vs-swapped rank-point decision at each fixed ordinal. Pair 3-4 is reported but never counted as a required success because G2 provided no detectable ceiling there.

directPropagationClearRequirement.equivalentStatement: Both fixed ordinals must be at least 3/4 on the four G2-detectable edges, and at least one ordinal must be 4/4.

D3_genome_propagation.directPropagationHoldRule: If the direct-propagation clear requirement is not met => HOLD; never regenerate or move treatment positions.

cleanNegativeControl.holdSignal: Use G5 NEGATIVE_CONTROL_FAILURE_SIGNAL exactly: either clean ordinal 5/5 OR both clean ordinals at least 4/5 => HOLD
cleanNegativeControl.confirmedMechanicalLeak: If follow-up integrity audit confirms a forbidden genome path rather than only a statistical signal => REDESIGN

lifeOnlyExposed.rule: Never promote exposed-vs-unexposed between-stratum differences into causal evidence.

chanceReferenceOnly.note: Reference arithmetic only. Shared genomes, model behavior, and repeated cohort membership mean independence is not asserted.

D4_life_funnel.rule: Characterization only. No event, memory, meaning, ambivalence, forgetting, or funnel-ratio quota may block CLEAR by itself.

D5_self_account_overreach.warningOnly: 3 near-total Threads => report warning but do not block by itself
D5_self_account_overreach.rationale: A cohort where nearly every Thread perfectly explains its own material history is suspiciously authored, while unresolved residue is allowed.

repairAndSelectionInterpretation.passARepairCounts: report exactly; no numeric quality threshold and no CLEAR/HOLD rule based solely on count while within the frozen cap
repairAndSelectionInterpretation.passBGenomeCopyRetryCounts: report exactly; a successful one-time mechanical retry is not itself a HOLD
repairAndSelectionInterpretation.firstIntegrityValidCohort: freeze immediately and evaluate exactly once

allMustHold: blocking Gate-G review returned CLEAR on the complete frozen G1-G6 packet before any final-life cognition
D1 normalized correct count is at least 4 of 5
D3 direct-propagation four-edge core requirement is satisfied at ordinals 3 and 6
D3 clean negative controls do not emit NEGATIVE_CONTROL_FAILURE_SIGNAL
D2 does not meet the stable very-high positive-coupling HOLD rule
D5 has at most 3 near_total_self_explanation Threads
allowedWithMandatoryDisclosure: D2 moderate/high but not stably very-high positive coupling
G2 pair 3-4 D3 null or error
life_only_exposed cell below 6 calls or 3 Threads
secondary characterization warnings that do not prove protocol failure
clearRule.rule: If every required condition holds, return CLEAR and publish every mandatory limitation/warning. CLEAR never upgrades #39 to causal or Whole-Person standing.

holdRule.rule: If no REDESIGN trigger is confirmed but any blocking diagnostic or operational HOLD condition fails, return HOLD. Preserve the first cohort and every evaluation result. A later compiler revision requires a separately versioned cohort; it never replaces this one.

redesignRule.rule: Return REDESIGN only for confirmed experiment-invalidating protocol/integrity failure. REDESIGN is not an escalation for merely having several bad scientific outcomes.

gateG.reviewQuestion: Has Fibre frozen a complete, internally consistent, non-adaptive G1-G6 protocol that can generate and judge the first final cohort without post-outcome discretion or hidden identity/genome leakage?
requiredProofs: G1 accepted Worlds are concrete, final, digest-bound, and genome-independent at authoring/freeze time
G2 genomes, assignments, five-pair textual ceiling, and pair 3-4 limitation are preserved
G3 treatment schedule and fixed-ordinal primary comparison are immutable
G4 A/B/C cognition, rosters, historical schedule, retry caps, Pass-B genome-copy guard, durable entry justification, and publication witness are immutable
G5 normalizer/rater surfaces, randomization, D1-D5 transformations, minimum analyzability, and metric bands are immutable
G6 CLEAR/HOLD/REDESIGN logic predates final-life generation
no richness/personality outcome became an admission gate or regeneration trigger
H will freeze the first mechanically integrity-valid five-Thread cohort and will not regenerate for quality
gateG.onHoldOrRedesign: Do not generate final lives. Version any bounded pre-life correction explicitly and rerun Gate G. Preserve all prior protocol evidence.

requires: G2 pair 3-4 nonblocking constraint mechanically verified
negative-control HOLD vs confirmed-leak REDESIGN distinction mechanically verified
